name: Renick Valley Meats
old_description: Your trusted source for commercial and custom processing and quality local meats in Renick, WV.
about:
Renick Valley Meats operates in Renick, West Virginia, where it was founded in 2022 by Jesse Zimmerman and Anna Gajewski. The pair took over the existing Countryside Meat Processing facility and rebranded it, aiming to strengthen the local food system through a family-owned, state-inspected operation.

The company provides custom and commercial processing for beef, pork, lamb, goat, and yak. Services include commercial slaughter and processing, on-site slaughter, hand-blended sausage seasoning, custom labeling, and a seasonal retail shop selling cuts from its own farm and local partners. The facility operates under West Virginia Department of Agriculture inspection and holds a commercial meat processing license obtained in 2024. A small team including Anna, Jesse, Ben, Jamie, Derrick, and Hank handles daily operations.

Primary customers are livestock farmers in West Virginia and Virginia who need processing for resale within the state, as well as local families purchasing retail cuts, meat boxes, and bundles. The business also serves the broader community by supplying locally sourced meat directly to consumers.

The founders state their mission is to connect families with real, local meat while supporting regenerative agriculture and local economies. They emphasize ethical handling, eco-friendly processing, and personalized butchery as core differentiators.
